ev.q: Twenty-nine institutions in 16 states have reported recovery of Ralstonia spp. from Vapotherm devices and from approximately 40 pediatric patients.
CDC continues to receive information regarding Ralstonia spp. associated with Vapotherm use.
FDA and CDC currently recommend use of alternative devices until the source of contamination can be identified.

methods_quotes.q: Based on pulsed field gel electrophoresis analysis
